steps.text: Starting landscape tile (three connected tiles) in the middle
Shuffle each tier of landscape tiles separately
Tier-2 deck facedown, tier-1 deck on top of it as one deck
All monster army tokens in the bag
Dark General standee, Praetorian tokens and the Plague token by the bag
Resource tray (food, wood, stone and Unit dice) within everyone's reach
Each player: a Hero board, 1 city token, {l} life tokens (heart up) and 6 building tokens (grey side up) on their spaces
Shuffle the 6 Hero cards facedown; each player draws 1 onto their board; box the rest
steps.note: Or choose heroes in die-roll order

steps.text: Your Hero's city token in front of you, grey (unbuilt) side up

details: War Strategy: once per battle, may reroll all the Unit dice (not the Hero die) and keep the second roll
Plunder: after winning a battle, gains resources as if he had gathered on that tile
Fate-weaver: on a new tile, draws 1 extra monster token, places as usual and returns the extra one
Expert Builder: the city and every building cost her 1 resource less (her choice)
Hawkeye: once per turn, for free, lay the top landscape tile anywhere reachable with its monsters, without moving there
Bear Friend: starts with an extra Bear die in her color that does not count against her Unit die limit
Necromancy: spend actions to add Skeleton dice in his color, up to 3, outside his glory limit
Soul Collector: heals 1 life each time one of his Units dies in combat
Combat Finesse: once per battle, may reroll the Hero die and keep the second roll
Magic Run: once per turn, instead of moving, goes up to 3 explored tiles in a straight line over chasms; must stop at an undefeated monster army
Terrain Exploration: on unexplored ground, draws 2 landscape tiles, places 1 and returns the other to the top unseen
Claws and Fangs: defeats one strength-1 monster army on his tile automatically (Dark General: discards a praetorian token first)

steps.text: 2 actions per turn; before each action you may move 1 tile
